topStories.headline: FOMC Kicks Off Two-Day Meeting as Rate Hike Seen Near-Certain
topStories.summary: The Fed's September 15-16 meeting opened with markets pricing an 83% chance of a 25bps hike — the first since 2023 — as August CPI and strong payrolls cemented hawkish expectations.
topStories.marketImpact: US Treasuries under pressure; 10Y yield tested 5.01% intraday; rate-sensitive sectors ↓; USD ↑

topStories.headline: Brent Crude Surges to ~$108 After Saudi Arabia Shuts East-West Pipeline Following Attacks
topStories.summary: Attacks on infrastructure in Riyadh and Madinah forced Saudi Arabia to temporarily suspend its 7 mb/d East-West pipeline, compounding Hormuz tanker disruptions and pushing Brent up ~9% for the week.
topStories.marketImpact: Brent crude ↑ ~4% to ~$108/bbl; WTI ~$103; energy stocks ↑; airlines and industrials ↓; broader inflation outlook ↑

topStories.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs Call for AI Development Slowdown, Rattling Tech Stocks
topStories.summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published an essay warning of rogue AI agents within six months and proposed 'pacing' frontier AI development; OpenAI's Sam Altman and Google's AI chief quickly agreed.
topStories.marketImpact: Nasdaq 100 ↓ 0.8%; Philly Semiconductor Index ↓ 5.9%; Nvidia ↓ 3.4%; Intel ↓ 5.6%; AI capex story under scrutiny ↓

topStories.headline: US August CPI Rises 3.4% YoY, Core at 2.4%, Cements September Fed Hike
topStories.summary: Headline CPI rose 0.4% MoM in August driven by energy, with core at +2.4% YoY matching forecasts, pushing Fed funds futures to 89% odds of a September hike.
topStories.marketImpact: Front-end yields ↑; growth stocks ↓; financials ↑; rate-sensitive bonds ↓

topStories.headline: China August Retail Sales +4.6% and Industrial Output +4.5% Both Beat Forecasts
topStories.summary: China's NBS reported August retail sales at +4.6% YoY (vs. 3.0% est) and industrial production at +4.5% YoY (vs. 3.9% est), a broad beat after months of disappointing activity data.
topStories.marketImpact: CNY ↑; HK and mainland equities stabilised; stimulus timeline remains uncertain — watch ↔

topStories.headline: BOJ on Track for 25bps Hike on September 18; Yen Carry Trade in Focus
topStories.summary: With 97% of BOJ watchers expecting Governor Ueda to raise the policy rate to 1.25% on September 18, the coinciding Fed and BOJ decisions mark the first time both central banks tighten in the same week this cycle.
topStories.marketImpact: JPY ↑; Nikkei volatile — fell 0.81% Monday, recovered 0.4% Tuesday; yen carry-trade unwind risk ↑

topStories.headline: Kioxia Considers Raising $10 Billion Through US ADR Listing
topStories.summary: Japanese memory chipmaker Kioxia Holdings, whose shares have surged ~400% on AI-driven NAND demand, is in early talks with BofA, Goldman, and JPMorgan about listing American depositary receipts on a US exchange.
topStories.marketImpact: 285A.T ↑ 2.5%; US NAND peers (Micron) watch; ADR listing could enable semiconductor index inclusion ↑

topStories.headline: 10-Year Treasury Yield Briefly Tops 5% for First Time Since 2023
topStories.summary: The US 10-year Treasury note yield touched 5.01% intraday Monday, its highest level since 2023, as surging energy prices and FOMC expectations compounded bond market weakness.
topStories.marketImpact: Bonds ↓ across the curve; equities under pressure; mortgage rates ↑; TLT ↓
